contract.intent: Make the shaping phase concrete in the flow: name the idea-to-plan phase shaping (spec remains the name of the final document only), and make depth conditional on the grill so a solid small/clear idea runs straight to a light spec without a vision step, while a full vision still runs for genuinely ambiguous ideas.
acceptanceCriteria: Naming: the definition side of the flow is called shaping in the chain template, generated docs, and companion guide; nothing calls the whole phase specs; the final document is still called spec
Depth routing: a solid low-ambiguity idea runs without a vision step (test: no vision artifact is produced for that case)
Full path preserved: an ambiguous idea still produces vision then spec (test)
Proportionate interaction: the grill gathers the depth signal and any open questions in a bounded batched session; the human never re-authors a prior artifact
Proven green: suite passes; check and verify hold at the accepted baselines; the conditional path is expressed in the flow chain data, not hard-coded per step
expectedOutputs: conditional chain (vision optional by grill verdict)
